title: Quiz: Print and Media Queries
description: Check your understanding of Print and Media Queries.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: What does prefers-reduced-motion do?
options: Lets users request less animation for accessibility
questions.correctAnswer: Lets users request less animation for accessibility
questions.explanation: Vestibular disorders make motion sickness real — respect the setting.

questions.question: True or False: You can hide navigation and buttons when printing a page.
Fill in the blank: @media (max-width: 600px) { ... }  // target ${screens}
questions.explanation: Media queries branch styles on device conditions.

questions.question: In HTML, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
